Healer tags: heal/direct/hot, ability:Totems; Elemental tags: ability:Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning/Shock/Flame Shock/Fire Totems; Enhancement tags: white/mainhand/type:melee, ability:Windfury Weapon, ability:Rockbiter Weapon, ability:Lightning Shield. mana_share tag dmgspell = share of mana spent on damage spells per model.

Elemental Warding.note: -3%/rank Fire/Frost/Nature damage taken: ~30% of incoming damage while leveling is spell damage. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: -10% Fire/Frost/Nature damage taken. The survival term already counts it at ~30% spell damage; mages, shamans, druids, poisons and Destruction warlocks push that share higher in PvP.

At 60 a Lava Burst is ~1.3x a Lightning Bolt (189-211, 2.5s, 71.4%) in the same cast time and replaces one of every four bolts -> ~+8% on the Lightning Bolt share. Raid sim calibration [elemental-dps] (2026-10-26, wowsims/forever 30f67f5d2, elemental-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 5.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x2.51 to match (5.8%). Other modes unchanged. 2026-09-27 audit: split: the Stoneclaw half is control of kind stun (taunted mobs hit the totem; biggest in pulls of several mobs), the Earthbind half kite. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, kite: Earthbind Totem radius +20% (10 -> 12 yd), likely also the reach of the Earthbound root. The Stoneclaw +50% health half only taunts pets in PvP.
